Video of the engine starting and idling with audible sound
Full 360-degree photos including underside, all sensors, manifolds, and wiring harness
Any documentation (invoice, import papers, or source vehicle odometer) showing history/mileage
Leak check video after a short run (oil, coolant, fuel lines)
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a used car engine assembly, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified, condition-unknown generic engine; the Volkswagen Passat/Sharan fitment and 'quality' claims remain unverifiable remote until engine-code and running-condition proof is supplied.
